bio: Carmela Conroy (born April 17, 1962) is an American diplomat, politician, and former career Foreign Service officer who served as the U.S. consul general in Lahore, Pakistan, during the 2011 Raymond Davis incident, a diplomatic crisis between the United States and Pakistan.

items.t: Expressed support at a 2026 primary candidate forum for dismantling Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS); she later denied making those statements.

items.t: Has advocated for gender-affirming care to be treated as healthcare under Medicaid.

items.t: Ran an explicitly pro-Israel campaign in 2024, then called for an arms embargo in her 2026 campaign.
